note.alt: A cramped nighttime alley with red lanterns, food stalls and stacked air-conditioning units overhead.
note.description: Red lanterns and small shop windows warm a narrow passage crowded with machinery. The view looks up through pipes and outdoor units, finding a welcoming glow inside the city’s tangled layers.

note.alt: A quiet city crossing with patches of snow, green shop signs and tall buildings beneath a clear blue sky.
note.description: Patches of snow collect at the edges of a quiet crossing. A clear blue sky opens above the shopfronts and apartment blocks, letting winter daylight soften the dense geometry of the street.

note.alt: A narrow stepped passage between dense buildings covered in cables, pipes and air-conditioning units.
note.description: A steep passage winds between buildings layered with cables, vents and pipes. The close walls frame a pale opening in the distance, drawing the eye through a maze of small urban details.

note.alt: A small bedroom with a bed, plants, a desk and a television, washed in orange light from outside.
note.description: Orange light stretches across a bed and onto the floor of a small room. A desk, plants and a television gather around its edges, turning an ordinary bedroom into a quiet pocket of evening warmth.

note.alt: An autumn alley with tangled branches, stairs, scattered leaves and walls covered in pipes and outdoor units.
note.description: Fallen leaves gather around the steps of a tightly packed alley. Bare branches reach into the same space as pipes and cables, weaving the season into the city’s busy surfaces.

note.alt: A pale moon above a dark street, with red buildings, glowing shops, utility poles and overhead cables.
note.description: A pale moon hangs above dark shopfronts and red buildings. Utility poles and overhead wires divide the muted sky, while a few illuminated windows keep the street quietly awake.

note.alt: A bright urban stairway with Japanese shop signs, hanging lanterns, overhead cables and blue sky.
note.description: Sunlight falls over concrete stairs and layered shop signs. Lanterns, wires and balconies frame patches of blue sky, giving a busy corner of the city a light, unhurried atmosphere.

note.alt: A sunlit street with railings, vending machines, apartment balconies and a glimpse of water beyond.
note.description: Railings and apartment balconies frame a bright street near the water. Vending machines and overhead wires bring familiar city details into a scene opened up by light, greenery and the distant shore.
